tagline: 潘泰康数码单反相机，1989 年发布
description: 潘泰康于1989年推出的数码单反相机。快门速度electronically controlled metal focal plane shutter, speeds B, 1, 1/5, 1/10, 1/30, 1/60 (flash synch.), 1/125, 1/250, 1/500, 1/1000, mechanical fixed speed 1/60 sec。使用35mm with speeds 12 to 3200 ASA。

specs.卡口: Praktica bayonet with EDC (electronic diaphragm control)
specs.快门: electronically controlled metal focal plane shutter, speeds B, 1, 1/5, 1/10, 1/30, 1/60 (flash synch.), 1/125, 1/250, 1/500, 1/1000, mechanical fixed speed 1/60 sec
specs.曝光测光: TTL with cadmium sulfide photo resistor
specs.取景器: Pentaprism finder, shows 95% of image, ground glass screen with split image and microprism focusing aid, red, green and yellow LEDs for exposure time control
specs.英文简介: The BCS is a 35mm SLR camera released by Praktica in 1989.
